as_told.title: Robert Maxwell, Nazi scientists and Pergamon Press

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Robert Maxwell, a man he describes as working for MI6 (Britain's foreign intelligence service), questioned Nazi German scientists in Germany after the Second World War, something Michels says hardly anyone knows. In a later episode he adds that Maxwell went on to own Pergamon Press, a publishing house, and credits the detail to a writer, Whitney Webb, and her book One Nation Under Blackmail. Michels raises it because, in his view, it would link a powerful figure to the scientific secrets of the war's losers.
